tagline: An audio delivery pipeline AI agents can drive: a track and a target in, a spec-compliant master and a measured ship-or-not report out.

claim.text: BS.1770-4 loudness, loudness range and true peak pass the EBU Tech 3341 and 3342 conformance signals in the test suite, on every CI run.
